Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning guest artist licenses and licenses of nonresidents for the practice of body art, body piercing, or tattooing.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to body art, body piercing, and tattooing; andadding a new section to chapter 18.300 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.300 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of licensing may issue a guest artist license toa nonresident of Washington state who intends to engage in the practiceof body art, body piercing, or tattooing in this state. Guest artistsmust meet the requirements of RCW 18.300.040 and practice in accordancewith department rules. Guest artist licenses may be issued for aperiod of up to thirty days. The department may adopt rules relatingto renewal or reissuance of guest artist licenses. (2) The department of licensing may issue an individual operatorlicense to a nonresident of Washington state if the applicant candemonstrate at least three consecutive years of documented experiencepracticing in the profession of body art, body piercing, or tattooingand that this experience occurred within the fiveyear period before p. 1 SSB 5074the date of the application.
